corrections.reason: The cited Ge'ez lemma matches L16 'ዝየኒ' ('here also'); visually the glyph has the top-left bar of 'ኒ' rather than 'ሂ'.
Amharic 2nd person singular imperative translating Ge'ez 'ፈንወነ' is 'እዘዘን' ('command/permit us', 6th-order 'እ'), matching the printed glyph.
Contextual Amharic circumstantial form 'እንደ ከብት እያረቡ' ('raising them like cattle', with 6th-order 'እ') rather than negative 'አያረቡ'.
Amharic elided ablative 'ካገራችን' (ከ + አገራችን, 4th-order 'ካ') translating Ge'ez 'እምደወሎሙ', clearly showing the shortened right leg of 'ካ'.
